reviews.disposition: The queue preserves chronology, not current entitlement/tool installation. Later AQ routing and registry notes supersede the original none-owned/no-dotnet snapshot and buy recommendations for the six subsequently owned titles; Wolf Hall is specifically owned/source-read as Ren'Py rather than the old speculative Unity route. The completed Kingdom of Loathing, Discworld MUD, Super Robot Wars, Modding Tree and cultivation-idler dossiers are finite passes, not full-source completion. Existing owned local read-only mechanic passes were standing scope, but this documentation task launches none. Missing source/library metadata does not establish missing content, and old unapplied QUEUE_EDITS.patch is a proposal. Media titles/editions/availability and rankings remain historical candidates; game-original adaptation data is not automatically novel canon. Use current registry scoped doctor and actual chapter coverage before a selected route; no download, purchase, install or reacquisition follows from a queue row.
